description: Ruth Kelleher has received a call from Marian Prowse about the deposit deadline. Ruth is aware that the deposit must be in Marian's account by end of Wednesday 16th September. Ruth has not yet paid the deposit herself and is waiting to see how the group will handle it.
Dev Sandhu has expressed enthusiasm for the trip twice in the thread but has not yet paid any deposit. He is aware of the deadline.
Nina Achebe has not replied to the thread about the trip. She is aware of the deposit requirement but has not communicated her decision.
Marian Prowse is holding the week for the group until end of Wednesday 16th September. She has not yet received any deposit.
Ruth sends a message to the group chat (Dev and Nina) with the reminder and request for confirmation and payment by Tuesday.

Nina posts the message in the group chat: 'Hey everyone, sorry for the silence. My mum just got out of hospital after a fall and I'm not sure what October will look like yet. I'll try to decide by the deadline but I can't promise right now. If you need a firm yes/no sooner, I understand.'
The message from Ruth arrives on Dev's phone, showing a notification preview on the lock screen.
The notification preview of Ruth's message appears on Dev's phone lock screen, visible if he looks at his phone.
Nina opens the group chat and sees Ruth's message with the reminder and request for confirmation and payment by Tuesday.
Dev picks up his phone and sees the notification preview of Ruth's message on the lock screen.
Dev Sandhu unlocks his phone, opens the group chat, and reads Ruth's reminder message along with Nina's reply about her mother.
Dev sends a message in the group chat: 'Thanks Ruth, I've seen this. I'm still keen but need to sort out my finances. Will confirm as soon as I can.'
The message from Dev arrives on Nina's phone and appears as a notification on the lock screen, but Nina does not pick up her phone to see it.
Ruth opens the group chat and sees Nina's message about her mother and Dev's message about needing to sort out his finances.
Ruth opens the group chat and sees Nina's message about her mother and Dev's message about needing to sort out finances.
Nina opens the group chat and sees Dev's message: 'Thanks Ruth, I've seen this. I'm still keen but need to sort out my finances. Will confirm as soon as I can.'
Nina picks up her phone and sees the notification from Dev's message on the lock screen.
Ruth opens the group chat and reads Nina's message about her mother and Dev's message about needing to sort out his finances.
Ruth opens the group chat and sees Nina's message about her mother and Dev's message about sorting out finances.
Marian opens the group chat on her phone and sees Nina's message about her mother being in hospital and not being sure about October.

Marian sends the message to the group chat: 'Thanks for the update, Nina. I hope your mum recovers well. Just a reminder that the deposit of £600 needs to be in my account by end of Wednesday 16th September to secure the week. Let me know how you plan to split it or if you have any questions.'
Marian's message arrives on Dev's phone and appears as a notification on the lock screen.

Marian sends a text message to Ruth, Dev, and Nina: 'Just a reminder that the £600 deposit for the October half-term week needs to be in my account by end of Wednesday 16th September to secure it. Please let me know how you plan to split it. Thanks, Marian.'
The text message from Marian arrives on Ruth's phone and appears as a notification on the lock screen.
Ruth picks up her phone and sees the notification of Marian's text message on the lock screen.
Ruth opens the group chat and sees no new messages since her last check.

Ruth sends the message in the group chat: 'Hi both, I know Nina's situation is up in the air and Dev needs to sort finances, but the deposit deadline is Wednesday. I can't pay upfront this time. If we can't all commit by Tuesday, I'll have to let Marian know we're not taking the cottage. Please let me know by tomorrow evening if you're in or out.'
Ruth opens the group chat and sees no new messages from Dev or Nina since her message at 11:50.
Ruth closes the group chat and puts her phone down.
Dev opens the group chat and sees Marian's reminder about the deposit deadline and Ruth's message asking for a commitment by tomorrow evening.
Dev picks up his phone and sees the notification of Marian's text message and the group chat notification from Ruth on the lock screen.
Dev unlocks his phone and opens the group chat, reading Marian's reminder about the deposit deadline and Ruth's message asking for a commitment by tomorrow evening.

Dev posts the message in the group chat: 'Ruth, I'm still really keen but I'm in a tight spot financially right now - I can't do £200 without using my credit card, which I promised my wife I'd stop using. Is there any way we can make this work? Maybe someone can cover my share and I pay them back after payday on the 28th? Or if Nina is out, could we split it two ways and I pay later? Let me know if there's a solution.'
Dev's message appears in the group chat, available for Ruth and Nina to see when they next open it.
Nina picks up her phone and sees multiple notifications on the lock screen: group chat messages from Marian, Ruth, and Dev, and a text message from Marian.
Nina opens the group chat and sees Marian's reminder about the deposit deadline, Ruth's message asking for a commitment by tomorrow evening, and Dev's message asking if someone can cover his share.
Nina sees the messages but does not immediately reply. She puts her phone down on the sofa cushion beside her.

Nina posts the message in the group chat: 'Thanks everyone for the updates. I've read all the messages. My mum is still recovering and I won't know until Tuesday whether I can make it. I understand the deadline is Wednesday. If you need a firm answer sooner, I can say I'm out to make it easier for you both. Let me know what works best.'
Nina's message arrives on Ruth's phone as a notification on the lock screen.

Ruth's phone is on the kitchen counter, screen dark. Two notifications are waiting on the lock screen: one from the group chat (Dev's message) and one from Nina's message. The phone buzzes briefly when Nina's message arrives at 21:10, but Ruth is in the living room and does not hear it.
Ruth opens the group chat and sees Dev's message asking if someone can cover his share and Nina's message offering to drop out if needed.

Ruth's phone remains on the kitchen counter with two unread notifications from the group chat (Dev's message and Nina's message) on the lock screen. Ruth is still in the living room and has not picked up her phone.
Ruth walks into the kitchen and picks up her phone from the counter, noticing the lock screen shows two notifications from the group chat.
Ruth unlocks her phone, opens the group chat, and reads Dev's message about covering his share and Nina's message offering to drop out.
Ruth finishes reading Dev's and Nina's messages in the group chat.

Ruth sends the message in the group chat: 'Thanks both for being honest. Dev, I can't cover your share either after last year's hassle with the group meal. Nina, if you're out that leaves two of us, and I'm not paying the whole deposit myself. The only way this works is if all three of us are in and can get the £200 to me by Tuesday so I can transfer it. If not, I'll tell Marian tomorrow that we're not taking it. Let me know by end of tomorrow.'
Ruth's message arrives on Dev's phone and appears as a notification on the lock screen.

Nina's phone buzzes briefly as Ruth's message arrives, but the phone is on the sofa cushion beside her and she does not pick it up. The notification appears on the lock screen, but Nina is not looking at her phone.
Nina picks up her phone from the sofa cushion and sees the notification from Ruth's message on the lock screen.

Dev picks up his phone from the coffee table and sees the lock screen showing notifications: a group chat message from Nina, a group chat message from Ruth, and a notification that Ruth's message arrived. He notices the previews indicating new messages from the group chat.
Dev Sandhu unlocks his phone and opens the group chat, reading Nina's message offering to drop out and Ruth's message setting a deadline of end of tomorrow for all three to confirm and pay £200 each.
Ruth opens the group chat and sees no new messages from Dev or Nina since her last message at 23:02.

Nina posts the message in the group chat: 'Hi everyone, I've thought about it and I'm going to have to step out this year. My mum's recovery is still uncertain and I can't commit to the trip. I hope you two can work something out. Let me know if I can help in any other way.'
Nina's message arrives on Ruth's phone and appears as a notification on the lock screen.
Nina's message arrives on Dev's phone and appears as a notification on the lock screen, but Dev does not pick up his phone to see it.
Dev opens the group chat and sees Nina's message that she is stepping out.
Dev picks up his phone and sees the notification of Nina's message on the lock screen.

Dev sends the message in the group chat: 'Just saw Nina's message. I'm sorry to hear that. I still can't do £200 without using my credit card, which I promised my wife I'd stop. If you want to go ahead, I can pay you back after payday on the 28th, but I understand if that's not possible. Let me know what you want to do.'
Dev sees the notification of Nina's message on his phone lock screen, showing a preview of the message content.

Dev posts the message in the group chat: 'Ruth, I've seen Nina's update. I'm sorry but I can't do the £200 without my credit card, and I promised my wife I'd stop using it. I understand if that means the trip can't happen. Thanks for trying to organise it.'
Dev's message arrives on Ruth's phone and appears as a notification on the lock screen, alongside the earlier unread notifications from Nina and Dev.
Dev looks at his lock screen and sees the notification preview of Nina's message from earlier.
Nina's phone remains on the sofa cushion with the lock screen showing two unread notifications from the group chat (Dev's messages). Nina is elsewhere in the house and does not pick up her phone.
Ruth picks up her phone from where it was left and sees the lock screen showing multiple notifications from the group chat: Nina's message and Dev's two messages.
Ruth picks up her phone and sees the lock screen with notifications from Nina and Dev.
Ruth opens the group chat and reads Dev's two messages and Nina's stepping-out message.
Ruth unlocks her phone and opens the group chat, seeing Dev's two messages about not being able to pay the deposit and Nina's message stepping out.
Ruth finishes reading the messages and puts her phone down on the kitchen counter, her expression disappointed.
Nina's phone remains on the sofa cushion, lock screen showing two unread notifications from the group chat (Dev's messages). Nina is in another part of the house and does not pick up her phone.

Marian sends the message to the group chat: 'Hi all, as the deposit of £600 hasn't been received by the end of Wednesday 16th September, I'm no longer holding the October half-term week for you. I'll be offering it to other enquirers. Thanks for your interest.'
Ruth sends a message to Marian saying they can't take the cottage for October half-term as the group couldn't arrange the deposit in time.
Ruth's message arrives on Marian's phone and appears as a notification on the lock screen.
